text: ___ is the in vitro selection method used to enrich high-affinity nucleic acid aptamers from a random library over repeated rounds of binding, recovery, and amplification.
explanation: SELEX (Systematic Evolution of Ligands by Exponential enrichment) incubates a random nucleic acid library with a target, recovers the bound sequences, and amplifies them over repeated rounds, typically 8 to 15, to enrich for high-affinity aptamers. It is the nucleic-acid analog of phage display, which performs an equivalent enrichment role for protein and peptide binders.
